title: Cache or Denoise Less? Residual Reuse in a Flow-Matching World Action Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.19709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. translated_title: 缓存还是少去噪？流匹配世界动作模型中的残差复用
translated_abstract: 流匹配机器人策略通过反复的网络评估来生成每个动作块，每个去噪步骤需要进行一次网络评估。诸如 C$^3$ache 这类跨周期缓存会复用早期重规划调用中的计算，但它们是否优于简单地减少去噪步数尚不明确。我们在 Fast-WAM——一个 60 亿参数的世界动作模型——上，在 LIBERO-Goal 基准上对这两种方案进行了比较。仅两步（不使用缓存）即可保持十步的成功率：在全部 500 个初始状态上（针对一个检查点和一个噪声种子），其性能在两个百分点内不劣于十步。在 PyTorch 默认编译模式下，两步还将 RTX A6000 上一次重规划调用的时间从 202 毫秒缩短至 92 毫秒。这给缓存留下的加速空间很小。保留两步新鲜计算的缓存不可能比两步无缓存更快：每次调用仍然需要对图像进行编码、运行视频专家模块并计算这两步。根据我们的成本模型，缓存两步中的第一步（每四次调用刷新一次）最多只能节省单次调用成本的 11–14%。缓存策略还……
tldr: 研究发现，在流匹配机器人策略中，将去噪步数从十步减少到两步即可在保持成功率的同时大幅加速（一次重规划从 202ms 降至 92ms），从而给 C³ache 这类跨周期缓存方法留下的加速空间极小（最多约 11–14%）。
en_tdlr: In flow-matching robot policies, simply reducing denoising steps from ten to two preserves success rates and slashes replanning latency (202ms to 92ms), leaving minimal room for cross-cycle caching methods like C³ache to provide additional speedup (at most 11-14%).
